towers.name: Spear Watchtower
towers.description: A rugged platform hurling heavy spears.
towers.lore: Lashed logs, a platform and a pile of spears heavy enough to pin a kodo. The orc on top throws until he runs out of arms.

towers.name: Burning Pit
towers.description: Flings burning pitch that splashes across the pack.
towers.lore: Pitch, bone and the fire the shamans keep hungry. It flings a splash of it and the pack learns to scream together.

towers.name: Lightning Totem
towers.description: Shaman totem whose bolt leaps from creep to creep.
towers.lore: Carved by a shaman who owed the storm a debt. The bolt jumps from skull to skull until the debt is paid.

towers.name: Tar Pit
towers.description: Boiling tar that leaves the pack crawling.
towers.lore: Boiling black earth the horde learned to aim. Whatever walks through it keeps walking, slower, with the horde laughing.
